title: Chhath aur Karna ka Rahasya
style: hyper-real cinematic devotional film still, warm golden sunrise light, deep saturated colours, dramatic rim light, intricate detail, respectful, no text, no letters, no writing, no watermark, no signature
hook: Chhath ka arghya sabse pehle kisne diya?
source: Mahabharata (KM Ganguli): Vana Parva sec. 307, Udyoga Parva sec. 144, Adi Parva sec. 138; Anga = Bhagalpur-Munger (munger.nic.in); Chhath ki shuruaat Karna se: lok manyata
summary: Surya putra Karna ki roz ki Surya pooja (Mahabharata), Anga desh = Bhagalpur-Munger; jal mein khade hokar arghya ki parampara Karna se: lok manyata

scenes.prompt: Dramatic cinematic close-up portrait of the Mahabharata warrior Karna facing the camera, centered in the frame, a noble handsome young man with warm brown skin and a calm proud face, shining golden armour and round golden earrings, a huge rising sun glowing behind his head like a halo, river mist behind him, the face in the lower half of the frame
scenes.tts: छठ का अर्घ्य सबसे पहले किसने दिया था?
scenes.sub: Chhath ka arghya sabse pehle kisne diya tha?

scenes.prompt: Women devotees in bright saris standing in a river at sunrise seen from behind, raising bamboo soop baskets with fruits and lit diyas towards the rising sun, golden mist on the water, cinematic wide shot
scenes.tts: जल में खड़े होकर सूर्य को अर्घ्य, यह परंपरा कितनी पुरानी है? जवाब महाभारत में है।
scenes.sub: Jal mein khade hokar Surya ko arghya, yeh parampara kitni purani hai? Jawaab Mahabharat mein hai.

scenes.prompt: A young prince in royal silk placing a golden crown on the head of the warrior Karna in golden armour inside a grand ancient palace hall, courtiers watching, warm golden light, cinematic
scenes.tts: सूर्य पुत्र कर्ण को दुर्योधन ने अंग देश का राजा बनाया। अंग, यानी आज के बिहार का भागलपुर, मुंगेर इलाका।
scenes.sub: Surya putra Karna ko Duryodhan ne Ang desh ka raja banaya. Ang, yaani aaj ke Bihar ka Bhagalpur, Munger ilaka.

scenes.prompt: The warrior Karna in golden armour standing on the bank of a wide river at dawn with his back to the camera, both arms raised towards the rising sun, water dripping, golden light rays, cinematic wide shot
scenes.tts: महाभारत के अनुसार कर्ण रोज़ जल से निकलकर, हाथ जोड़कर सूर्य देव की पूजा करते थे।
scenes.sub: Mahabharat ke anusar Karna roz jal se nikalkar, haath jodkar Surya Dev ki pooja karte the.

scenes.prompt: Close view of the warrior Karna seen from behind on a river bank, golden armour glowing in strong morning sunlight, warm sunbeams falling on his back and shoulders, mist over the water, cinematic
scenes.tts: और तब तक प्रार्थना करते, जब तक सूरज की किरणें उनकी पीठ को गर्म न कर दें।
scenes.sub: Aur tab tak prarthana karte, jab tak Suraj ki kirnein unki peeth ko garm na kar dein.

scenes.prompt: A long line of devotees in a calm river at sunrise holding diyas and bamboo soop baskets towards a huge golden rising sun, a faint golden silhouette of an ancient warrior in the sky above them, epic cinematic wide shot
scenes.label: tradition
scenes.tts: लोक मान्यता है, कि जल में खड़े होकर अर्घ्य की यह परंपरा, कर्ण से ही शुरू हुई।
scenes.sub: Lok manyata hai, ki jal mein khade hokar arghya ki yeh parampara, Karna se hi shuru hui.

scenes.prompt: The noble warrior Karna with warm brown skin in shining golden armour on river ghat steps at sunrise, smiling kindly as he hands a golden pot to an old Brahmin with folded hands, warm golden light, cinematic
scenes.tts: उस समय जो भी माँगता, कर्ण कभी मना नहीं करते। इसीलिए वे दानवीर कहलाए।
scenes.sub: Us samay jo bhi maangta, Karna kabhi mana nahi karte. Isiliye ve Daanveer kehlaye.

scenes.prompt: A bamboo soop basket with fruits, thekua and a lit diya floating on a calm river at sunrise, golden rays across the water, peaceful, cinematic close shot
scenes.tts: सीख यही है, सूर्य जैसा तेज उसी को मिलता है, जो रोज़ नियम निभाए और दिल खोलकर दे।
scenes.sub: Seekh yahi hai, Surya jaisa tej usi ko milta hai, jo roz niyam nibhaaye aur dil kholkar de.

scenes.tts: छठी मैया सबकी मनोकामना पूरी करें! कमेंट में लिखें जय छठी मैया, और लाइक, शेयर, सब्सक्राइब करें।
scenes.sub: Chhathi Maiya sabki manokamna poori karein! Comment mein likhein Jai Chhathi Maiya, aur Like, Share, Subscribe karein.

facts.claim: Duryodhana made Karna (son of Surya) king of Anga
facts.source: Mahabharata, Adi Parva, Sambhava sub-parva, sec. 138 (KM Ganguli)

facts.claim: Anga comprised the modern Bhagalpur and Munger districts of Bihar
facts.source: Munger district administration (history); Bhagalpur district administration

facts.claim: Karna, rising from the water at midday, worshipped Surya with joined hands and gave away whatever was asked at that time
facts.source: Mahabharata, Vana Parva, Kundala-harana sub-parva, sec. 307 (KM Ganguli)

facts.claim: Karna said his prayers until his back was heated by the rays of the sun
facts.source: Mahabharata, Udyoga Parva, Bhagavat-yana sub-parva, sec. 144 (KM Ganguli)

facts.claim: Folk belief links the Chhath / Surya arghya tradition to Karna's sun worship (not a Mahabharata statement)
